purpose: Complete pinned public GMTKN55 evaluation of our own frozen candidates; establish an initial measured score before further sub-1 research
subset_means: Use pinned .average files, with BH76/.averageRC for BH76RC, exactly as the authors' corrected v1 calculator; also report unrounded means derived from the reference definitions for transparency
incomplete_prediction_policy: No full WTMAD-2 unless every reaction has all finite, converged, physically accepted predictions. Missing/failed reactions remain in the full denominator for a clearly labeled nonnegative lower bound, never a claimed passing score.
partial_estimation_policy: Do not extrapolate an opportunistic subset to a full-suite point estimate. Report actual coverage and failures; any later sampling estimate needs a prespecified probability design and uncertainty.
execution: All scientific arithmetic and benchmark scoring on CUDA float64, one host core, no CPU numerical fallback, no speed experiments, no frontier replication
private_tests: Public suite first as explicitly requested; no organizer private files or API available and no private-test pass claim
